panels.description: View from the threshold into the cold hidden workshop. Alex stands small at lower left. Dust hangs over blueprints, mechanical models, water-system diagrams and prototype devices. Riveted pre-Alpha pipes and analog gauges line the back wall. A chalkboard is dense with equations, including a distinctive looping form. An organized workbench sits under amber instrument light. A seated robot shape rests under a dust sheet with a faint amber pulse. An open box holds Adrian’s worn steel watch beside a tag reading FOR ALEX. 18. Reserve separate clear pockets above the workbench and near the upper corners; keep the watch, tag and robot shape unobstructed.
Alex lifts the watch from the box and turns it over. The looping equation engraved on its steel caseback catches amber light; his eyes move toward the chalkboard. Keep the watch and chalkboard clear.
The watch caseback is held beside the chalkboard. The looping equation is visibly identical in both places. No lettering over the equation.

At the workbench, the seated robot remains under the dust sheet with a faint amber pulse. Alex holds the watch and reaches toward the sheet without touching. The FOR ALEX. 18. tag remains visible. Reserve the upper third for the page-turn beat.
